title: B2 Milestone 1: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Felicidades! Has superado el Primer Hito del Nivel B2. Ahora dominas tiempos verbales complejos y vocabulario clave para negociaciones internacionales.

parts.visual:
En esta prueba repasaremos las lecciones 1 a 4 del nivel B2: 
- Mixed Conditionals (If I had invested, I would be rich). 
- Future Perfect & Continuous (Will have finished / Will be working).
parts.audio: In this test we will review lessons 1 to 4 of the B2 level: Mixed Conditionals, and Future Perfect and Continuous tenses.

parts.visual:
También repasaremos vocabulario avanzado de negocios: 
- Negociaciones (Leverage, compromise, deal-breaker). 
- Reuniones (Take the floor, wrap up, action items). 
¡Demuestra tu nivel!
parts.audio: We will also review advanced business vocabulary: Negotiations, and Meetings. Show your level!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta en este desafío integrador B2.

questions.question: If I had studied harder, I ____ a manager now. (Sería).
questions.explanation: Mixed conditional: Had studied (pasado) -> would be (presente).

questions.question: If we ____ the deadline yesterday, we wouldn't be working today. (No hubiéramos incumplido).
By next year, we ____ the new software. (Habremos lanzado).
questions.explanation: By next year = Future Perfect (will have launched).

questions.question: At 10:00 AM tomorrow, I ____ to Paris. (Estaré volando).
questions.explanation: Hora exacta = Future Continuous (will be flying).

questions.question: We have a lot of ____ in this negotiation because we are the only supplier. (Poder/Ventaja).
The high price was a ____ for us. We had to cancel the contract. (Factor decisivo para no firmar).
Let's reach a ____ so both companies are happy. (Acuerdo intermedio / Ceder).
I would like to take the ____ to explain our strategy. (La palabra).
We are getting ____. Let's return to the main topic. (Desviándonos).
Let's ____ up the meeting and assign the action items. (Resumir/Concluir).
If I ____ you, I would have accepted the offer. (Fuera).
By 5:00 PM, I ____ the report. (Habré terminado).
They want a ____. We have to give them something to get what we want. (Concesión).
Let's ____ the difference and agree on $150. (Partir).
We need to ____ this issue immediately. (Abordar/Tratar).
Who is going to ____ the meeting today? (Presidir/Dirigir).
We reached a ____. Nobody wants to negotiate anymore. (Punto muerto).
It's a ____ situation for everyone! (Ganar-ganar).
Please stick to the ____. We don't have much time. (Orden del día).
Could you ____ your microphone? (Silenciar).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra clave del nivel B2.

questions.question: If I had known, I ____ be happy now. (Estaría)
By tomorrow, I will ____ finished. (Habré)
I will ____ flying at 5 PM. (Estaré)
We have ____. (Ventaja/Poder con L)
A deal-____. (Factor de ruptura con B)
To reach a ____. (Acuerdo mutuo/Ceder con C)
Take the ____. (Tomar la palabra con F)
____ items. (Tareas a realizar con A)
Let's ____ up. (Terminar/Resumir con W)
To ____ an issue. (Abordar/Tratar con A)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la oración para tu examen final.
